ar: أبو عمران موسى بن عبيد الله ميمون

description.tr: Ortaçağın en büyük Yahudi filozofu ve hekimi — İslami, Yahudi ve Hristiyan entelektüel geleneklerinin birbirini besleyebileceğini kanıtladı || Mûsâ b. Meymûn, İslam medeniyetinin çapraz tozlaşmasını temsil eder. Müslüman Kurtuba'da eğitim, Fas'ta Müslüman alimler altında öğrenim, Arapça'da felsefe yazımı, Kahire'de Müslüman saraya hizmet — kariyeri tek bir gelenek içinde sınıflandırılamaz. || [Tarih notu] Stroumsa'nın Maimonides in His World (2009) eseri, Mûsâ b. Meymûn'u İslami entelektüel çevresinden izole olarak çalışma eğilimini sorguladı.
description.en: Greatest medieval Jewish philosopher and physician — proved that Islamic, Jewish, and Christian intellectual traditions could fertilize each other. Personal physician to Saladin's court while leading Cairo's Jewish community || Maimonides epitomizes the cross-pollination of Islamic civilization. Educated in Muslim Córdoba, trained under Muslim scholars in Fez, writing philosophy in Arabic for a Jewish audience, and serving a Muslim court in Cairo — his career is impossible to categorize within a single tradition. The Guide for the Perplexed, written in Judaeo-Arabic, synthesizes Farabi and Ibn Sina's philosophy with Talmudic reasoning. || [Historiographical note] Stroumsa's Maimonides in His World (2009) challenged the tendency to study Maimonides in isolation from his Islamic intellectual environment. The Cairo Geniza documents (over 300,000 fragments) provide unparalleled archival evidence of his daily life and medical practice.
description.ar: أعظم فيلسوف وطبيب يهودي في العصور الوسطى — أثبت أن التقاليد الفكرية الإسلامية واليهودية والمسيحية يمكن أن تخصّب بعضها بعضًا || موسى بن ميمون يجسّد التلاقح المتبادل للحضارة الإسلامية. تعلّم في قرطبة المسلمة وكتب الفلسفة بالعربية لجمهور يهودي وخدم بلاطًا مسلمًا في القاهرة
